description: Propose a googleProductCategory mapping for a feed: groups the latest run's delivered items by distinct productType, matches each onto Google's taxonomy (exact-path and unique-leaf matches first, then candidate-constrained AI when available and useAi is not false), and returns the mapping table WITH a ready-to-save rule definition (one lookup keyed on productType). NOTHING is saved: show the human the mapping, resolve unmatched product types with search_taxonomy and edit the rule's table, then save with create_rule — which runs the standard preview and returns the impact report. Options: onlyMissing=true scopes the rule to items with no category yet; defaultCategory (a valid taxonomy path) is applied to items whose productType is not in the table.

defaultCategory.description: Optional valid taxonomy path applied when an item's productType is not in the table.

onlyMissing.description: Scope the suggested rule to items with an empty googleProductCategory (default false: the reviewed mapping also fixes wrong existing values).

useAi.description: Use AI for product types with no deterministic taxonomy match (default true). AI mapping is rate-limited. When it is not available, call again with useAi=false for deterministic matches.
